Visitor wraps figure content with custom formatting

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorFigureCustomWrap struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorFigureCustomWrap) VisitFigureEnd(ctx htmd.NodeContext, output string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`%s
[/FIGURE]
`, output))
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorFigureCustomWrap) VisitFigureStart(ctx htmd.NodeContext) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(`
[FIGURE]
`)
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorFigureCustomWrap{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<section><h2>Gallery</h2><figure><img src="photo1.jpg" alt="Photo"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset</figcaption></figure></section>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
